description: Kubwo gukomanatra kw.imitima y.Abisirayeli, Imana ntiyashimye kujana nabo kugira ntibarandure barongowe n.umumalayika
name: Abisirayeli bakomeza urugendo

description: Uhoraho abarira Mose ngo yibutse abantu ukuntu ibakuje muri Egiputa ububasha buhambaye. Ica ibajana izinguzingu ibacishije mu bugaragwa
name: Abisirayeli barandurukabagenda berekeje I Sukoti ku kiyaga gitukura.

description: Imana ibereka uko bazorya wa mwagazi wa Pasika amaraso yawo akaba abibutsa ugucungurwa nk’uko amaraso ya Yesu atwibutsa ugucungurwa kwacu. Mw’ijoro buca Abisirayel bagenda, Uhoraho atuma umumarayika wo kurandura imfura zose zo muri Egiputa. Ni ho Farawo yaza agondozwa akareka Abisirayeli bakagenda.
name: Abisirayeli barya umwagazi wa Pasika

description: Babonye babuze ivyo kurya batangura kwidodombera Mose ngo yari gupfuma ibareka bagapfira muri Egiputa baciteretse amassafuriya y’inyama.Ariko Imana ibarungikira manu, umutsima uvuye mu bubasha bwayo ibaha n’inkware zo kuyikoza.
name: Abisirayeli bidodombera Imana bamaze gushika mu bugaragwa

description: Imigenderanire hagati y’umntu n’Imana itegerezwa kwisunga amabwirizwa yayo
name: Amabwirizwa 10 y’Imana n’igicaniro

description: Imbere yuko ihema ryubakwa Imana yavuganira na Mose ku musozi Sinayi nawe akabibarira abantu
name: Amasezera-no n’impa- nuro ku migengeranire hagati y’Imana n’abantu

description: Farawo na we abonye bagiye yumva ko ahomvye cane aca ahagurutsa ingobo zo kubakurikira ngo abagarure. Ariko Imana ibajabutsa ikiyaga gitukura mu bitangaza bikomeye, ariko ingabo za Farawo Uhoraho azihonereza mu kiyaga. Abisirayeli bamaze kujabuka baca baririmbira Uhorabo indirimbo y’ishimwe.
name: Farawo akurikira Abisirayeli ngo abagarure

description: Ikimazi cazanwa ku gicaniro caba gishizwe mu gishingo c.uwagitangiwe nk.uko Kristo na we yatanzwe mu gishingo c’anaynyavyaha. Igice kimwe c’ico kimazi nico catanga abaherezi.
name: Ibimazi vyo kwishikana n.ivy.intasiba, ivyo kurya vy.abaherezi, igicaniro co kwoserezako imibavu

description: Mose yabwiwe n.Imana kujishisha impuzu yo gupfuka ihema
name: Ibindi bikoresho vyo mw.ihema ry.ibonaniro

description: Farawo yanka yuko Abisirayeli bojana n’abana babo ngo nihagende abagabo gusa. Icago c’umunani, hatera inzige mu gihugu cose. Ic’icenda hacura umwiza mu gihugu cose.
name: Ibindi vyago bibiri

description: Imana iteza muri Egiputa icago c’agahebuza ca cumi: urupfu rw’ifura zose zo muri Egiputa baba abantu vyaba ibitungwa. Ariko mu Bisirayeli ntihagira n’uwuniha n’umutwe. Imana ibwira Abisirayeli ngo babage umwagazi utagira agasembw bawukoze umutsima utagira umwambiro n’imboga zirura, amaraso bayashire ku bishimaryango, kugura ngo umumarayika wo kurandura ni yaza akabona ayo maraso ace arengana.
name: Icago nyamukuru:urupfu rw’imfura zose

description: Mose amaze gukora ihema ry.ibonaniro Imana yamugeze gukora ameza y.imitsima
name: Ihema ry’Imana n’ivyari muri ryo.

description: Ukwanka Imana nya Mana kwakwegeye Abisirayeli ivyago ariko Mose arabasengera, Imana irabaharira
name: Ikigirwamana Aroni yacuriye Abisirayeli

description: Bamaze kugenda amezi atatu bashika mu bugaragwa bw’I Sinayi basagazaho. Basaba guhabwa ivyagezwe na yo ica irabibaha. Ivyagezwe vyatanzwe kugira ngo abantubamenye icaha n’ukuntu bocirinda.
name: Imana ibonekera Abisirayeli ku musozi Sinayi

description: Umwami wa Egiputa yabonye ko Abisirayeli bariko baragwira cane ategeka ko umwana w’umuhungu wese w’Umwisirayeli azovuka bazomuniga, ariko abakirizi bakabareka. Mose avutse, nyinaYokebedi amushira mu gatebo akanyegeza I ruhande y’uruzi. Umukobwa wa Farawo arakabona aja kugatunga. Amaze kugira imyaka 40, atabara Umwisirayeli yica umuntu bira menyekana. Mose aca ahungira I Midiyani.
name: Imana ikingira abana b’Abisirayeli uguhonywa

description: Imana ibarira Mose ngo agende akoranye abashingantahe b’Abisirayeli abumvishe ko Imana igomba kubakura mu buja. Imugabisha ko Farawo azobanza kwanka kubarekura ariko akagondozwa n’ibihano izocisha kuri Mose. Aca aritegura aja muri Egiputa
name: Imana ishishikara guha Mose ibimenyetso

description: Farawo akomantaza umutima, Imana imuteza ibindi vyago bitatu. Icago ca kabiri Ibikere bitera mu gihugu cose biruzura bifuka ahantu hose. Ica gatatu na co hatera imibu yuzura igihugu cose. Ica kane na co hatera ibibugu. Ivyo vyose ntivyagondoza Farawo
name: Imana itezaFarawo ibindi vyago bitatu.

description: Imana yongera kwemeza Mose yuko iri kumwe nawe. Farawo arushirije gucumukuza Abisirayeli Imana na yo ikomeza kuremesha Mose ngo atahure yuko yamaramaje kubabohoza.
name: Imana yagumye yitwararika Abisirayeli mu ngorane

description: Aha ni ho hatangura kuboneka intambara y’mana yo gutabara Abisirayeli. Farawo amaze gukomantaza umutima Imana ituma Mose abwira Aroni ati ramvurira inkoni ku mazi na yo aca acika amaraso mu gihugu cose.
name: Imana yongera kuremesha Mose ngo asubire kuja kuvugana na Farawo.

description: Imigenderanire hagati y.abantu itegerezwa kwisunga amabwirizwa y’Imana
name: Imigenderranire y’umuntu n’uwundi

description: Imana ituma Mose kuja kwa Farawo kumusaba ngo abarekure bave muri Egiputa. Farawo atangura kwanka ariko Imana imuteza ivyago bikomeye aragondozwa arabareka. Ariko bageze ku kiyaga gitukura babona ingabo za Farawo zabakurikiye. Imana ibajabutsa ikiyaga mu bitangaza ihonerezayo ingabo za Farawo. Baca babandanya urugendo baciye mu bugaragwa bagenda imyaka 40 babona gushika I Kanani.
name: Intangamarara y’igitabo co Kuvayo .

description: Bamaze kujabuka ikiyaga gitukura Mose n’Abisirayeli bararirimbira Uhoraho indirimbo y’ishimwe.
name: Inyigisho zavuye mu gitangaza co kujabutswa ikiyaga gitukura

description: Abantu bazanye n.umutima ukunze ivyo gukoresha ihema kugeza aho Mose ababuza kuko vyari bibaye umurengera. Maze Hesaleli umhinga arubaka
name: Isandugu ry.isezerano n.ibindi bikoresho vyari mw.ihema ry.ibonaniro

description: Ibikoresho vyose vyari kur.iryo hema vyari n.ico bisigura ku buzima bwa Yesu Kristo n.igikorwa ciwe
name: Ivy.imbaho n.ibitereko vy.ihema, impuzu yo ku muryango n.iyakingira ahera

description: Mu guca imanza no mu misi mikuru no mu ndimiro Abisirayeli bategerezwa kwisunga amabwirizwa y’Imana
name: Ivyagezwe bitandukanye vyahawe Abisirayeli

description: Farawo akomeje kwanka kwemera ububasha bw’Imana haca haza ibindi vyago . Ica gatanu ni ingwara y’akaryama, kica ibitungwa vyose vyo muri Egiputa ariko mu vy’Abisirayeli ntihapfamwo na kimwe. Ica gatandatu ibihute, ic’indwi na co hatera urubura.
name: Ivyago vya gatanu, gatandatu na ndwi

description: Abaherezi bamara imyambaro itandukanye, hari umwambaro wita efodi, umwambaro umeze nk’umupfuko wo kwambara mu gikiriza, igitambara co mu mutwe, ikanzu n’umukanda
name: Ivyambarwa vy’abaherezi

description: Abantu bazanye n.umutima ukunze ivyo gukoresha ihema kugeza aho Mose ababuza kuko vyari bibaye umurengera. Maze Hesaleli umhinga arubaka
name: Iyubakwa ry.ihema n.ibiri muri ryo

description: Babandanya urugendo bava kuri Sinai baja I Refidimu. Babura amazi Uhoraho atuma Mose ku gitandara c’I Horebu ngo agikubite amazi yisuke. Iyindi ngorane nuko Abamaleki babategereye bakabarwanya ariko Mose agasenga ashize amaboko hejuru Abisirayeli bagaca banesha. Mose arushe , Aroni na Huri bagasegura amaboko ya Mose, Abisirayeli bakanesha.
name: Izindi ngorane Abisirayeli bagiriye mu nzira yo mu bugaragwa

description: Ashitse I Midiyani ararongora avyara umwana amwita Gershomu. Imana imutuma kubohora Abisirayeli muri Egiputa. Mose atangura gutinya ako atazi no kuvuga neza, ariko Imana iramwibwira kandi imusezeranira kuzobana na we ikamushoboza vyose.
name: Mose aba umukozi w’Imana

description: Bakiri mu rugendo mu bugaragwa, abona sebukwe Yetiro aramugendeye ari kumwe na Zipora n’abahungubiwe babiri. Yetiro ahanura Mose gushiraho abomufasha kuza baraca imanza mu Bisirayeli. Aca atoranya abantu b’intungane bamifasha kuganza.
name: Mose agenderwa na sebukwe Yetiro

description: Mose aragenda Muri Egiputa, Farawo atangura gukomantaza umutima, Imana imwereka yuko ishobora kumuteza ingorane zikomeye mu gihe yobandanya.
name: Mose aja kurekuza Abisirayeli

description: Heslali yubatse ihema nk’uko Imana yabigeze kandi ikintu cose n.ibara ryaco Ivyo bikaba vyari ikigereranya c’igikorwa Yesu Kristo yari aje gukora mw’isi.
name: Ubwiza bw.Uhoraho mw.ihema ry.ibonaniro

description: Abasenga bakwiye kuba abejejwe ari naco gituma imbere y.ihema ry’ibonaniro hariho ikigarigari co gukarabirako imbere yo kwinjira
name: Ugusenga kw.abejejwe n.abarobanujwe amavuta
